Role & responsibilities Digital Marketing & AI Implementation Expert We are looking for a highly creative and results-driven Digital Marketing Expert with strong expertise in Meta & Google Ads, Social Media Marketing, Video Editing & Videography, Graphic Design, and AI Implementation & Automation . The ideal candidate will be responsible for planning and executing digital marketing campaigns, creating engaging content, implementing AI-powered solutions, and driving brand growth across multiple online platforms. Key Responsibilities: Plan, execute, and optimize Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads campaigns. Manage social media platforms including Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Google Business Profile. Create high-quality graphics, videos, reels, and promotional content for digital campaigns. Perform professional video shooting, editing, motion graphics, and content production. Monitor campaign performance, analyze KPIs, and generate actionable reports to improve ROI. Develop and execute branding, lead generation, and customer engagement strategies. Research, implement, and manage AI tools to automate marketing, content creation, customer engagement, and business workflows. Coordinate with software developers to integrate AI solutions into websites, CRM, ERP, chatbots, and business applications. Utilize AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Canva AI, and other automation tools to improve productivity and marketing effectiveness. Stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends, AI technologies, and platform updates to maintain a competitive edge. 
 Perks and benefits Food allowance, Provident fund, Annual bonus, Health insurance, Travel allowance, Life insurance, Accidental insurance, Sales incentives, Mobile bill reimbursements, Leave encashment
